items.title: Maple Leafs Acquire Forward Aatu Raty From Canucks In Three-Player Trade
items.detail: The Toronto Maple Leafs traded forwards Brandon Buhr and Jacob Quillan to the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday in exchange for Aatu Raty.
